basic_details.job_title: Civil Courts Lakhisarai Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Stenographer, Clerk and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Office of Principal District and Sessions Judge, Lakhisarai (Bihar) is engaging supportive staff for the Evening Court, Lakhisarai, on a contractual basis: one Stenographer, one Clerk and one Peon/Orderly, a total of 3 posts. Only retired employees of the Civil Courts may apply. The application must reach the office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Lakhisarai on or before 30 November 2026, either personally or through registered post.

qualification.details: The applicant must be a retired employee of the Civil Courts. Only those retired Court employees who have retired within the preceding three years, as per guidelines issued by the Hon'ble High Court, Patna, are eligible. The applicant must be physically and mentally fit to discharge the duties assigned to the respective post. The applicant must possess satisfactory service records and should not have been subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service. | The applicant must have the requisite experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing. | The applicant must have adequate knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work. | The applicant must be capable of performing the duties attached to the post. | The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification or an age limit for these posts. For the full eligibility of each post, refer to the official notification. | No amount is printed. The period of engagement, remuneration and other conditions shall be governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority. The engagement is purely contractual for the Evening Court, and selected candidates shall be required to perform their duties during the prescribed working hours of the Evening Court.

content_sections.heading: Lakhisarai Civil Court Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit, the pay, the application fee or the selection process.

content_sections.heading: About the Evening Court Engagement
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Office of Principal District and Sessions Judge, Lakhisarai, the district judiciary office of Lakhisarai in Bihar. It invites retired Civil Court employees to work as supportive staff in the Evening Court, Lakhisarai, and is to be circulated to all Judgeships of Bihar, so retired Civil Court staff from other districts of Bihar can also see it.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must reach the following office on or before 30 November 2026: Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Lakhisarai It may be submitted either personally (by hand) or through registered post. Since the notice fixes a date of receipt, an application sent by post must reach the office by 30 November 2026. The notice does not mention a prescribed application form, a fee or a list of enclosures.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The applicant must be a retired employee of the Civil Courts. Only those retired Court employees who have retired within the preceding three years, as per guidelines issued by the Hon'ble High Court, Patna, are eligible. The applicant must be physically and mentally fit to discharge the duties assigned to the respective post. The applicant must possess satisfactory service records and should not have been subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service. The applicant must have the requisite experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing. The applicant must have adequate knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work. The applicant must be capable of performing the duties attached to the post. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification or an age limit for these posts. For the full eligibility of each post, refer to the official notification. No amount is printed. The period of engagement, remuneration and other conditions shall be governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority. The engagement is purely contractual for the Evening Court, and selected candidates shall be required to perform their duties during the prescribed working hours of the Evening Court.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Lakhisarai Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies in the Evening Court, Lakhisarai: one each for Stenographer, Clerk and Peon/Orderly.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Lakhisarai on or before 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the Lakhisarai Evening Court posts?
faq.answer: Only retired employees of the Civil Courts who retired within the preceding three years, as per guidelines issued by the Hon'ble High Court, Patna, may apply. They must also be physically and mentally fit and have satisfactory service records.

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply for Lakhisarai Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Submit the application to the office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Lakhisarai either personally or through registered post, so that it reaches by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What experience is needed for the Stenographer post?
faq.answer: The applicant must have the requisite experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing.

faq.question: Q6. What is required for the Clerk post?
faq.answer: The applicant must have adequate knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely contractual for the Evening Court and does not confer any right to claim regular appointment or continuation in service.

faq.question: Q8. Can a retired employee who faced major disciplinary punishment apply?
faq.answer: No. The applicant must possess satisfactory service records and should not have been subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service.

faq.question: Q9. What are the working hours?
faq.answer: Selected candidates must perform their duties during the prescribed working hours of the Evening Court, Lakhisarai.
